plugins.name: Calculations
plugins.description: Works out ```calc code blocks line by line: sums, named values (rent = 1200) and totals, shown next to each line.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: A small calculator inside your notes for budgets, estimates and sizing. Each line is a sum (12 * 4), a named value (hours = 3 * 8) or a reference to earlier names (cost = hours * rate). "total" or "sum" adds up every result above it since the last total. Supports + − × ÷ % ^, brackets and round, floor, ceil, min, max, sqrt, abs. Lines starting with # are comments.

plugins.name: Change case
plugins.description: Commands to turn the selection (or the current line) into Title Case, Sentence case, UPPERCASE or lowercase.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Four commands in the command palette (F1 › Plugins). Title Case keeps short words like "and", "of" and "the" small (English) and leaves words that are already all capitals, like API or ADR, alone. Markdown around the text (# for headings, list markers) is kept.

plugins.name: Bar charts
plugins.description: Draws ```chart code blocks (one "label: number" per line, optional "title:") as bar charts.
plugins.author: Marky examples

plugins.name: CSV tables
plugins.description: Shows ```csv code blocks as tables. Commas, semicolons and tabs all work; the first row is the header.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Paste data from a spreadsheet or export into a ```csv block and it shows as a table in the preview and in exports, while the note keeps the plain data. Quoted values ("a, b") and numbers aligned to the right are handled. Up to 2,000 rows.

plugins.name: Emoji shortcodes
plugins.description: Shows :smile:, :tada:, :rocket: and other shortcodes as emoji in the preview.
plugins.author: Marky examples

plugins.name: Kanban board
plugins.description: Draws ```kanban code blocks as a board: a "## Column" line starts a column, "- card" lines are its cards.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Write a board as plain text, so it stays readable in any editor and in Git. Start a column with "## To do", add cards with "- Card". "- [x] Card" shows the card as done. Up to 8 columns of 30 cards.

plugins.name: Focus timer
plugins.description: A Pomodoro timer in the status bar: 25 minutes of writing, then a 5-minute break. Start, pause and set the lengths from the command palette.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Commands: "Focus timer: start or pause", "Focus timer: reset" and "Focus timer: set lengths". The status bar shows the time left; Marky tells you when a focus round or a break ends. Every fourth break is 15 minutes. The lengths you choose are remembered.

plugins.name: QR codes
plugins.description: Turns ```qr code blocks (a link or any text) into a QR code in the preview and in exports.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Handy for slides, printed handouts and posters: put a link in a ```qr block and it shows as a scannable code. Made on your computer (nothing is sent anywhere), up to about 2,000 characters, with medium error correction so a slightly damaged print still scans.

plugins.name: Readability
plugins.description: A side panel with the reading level of the open note (English and Dutch), reading time and its longest sentences.
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Shows the Flesch reading-ease score (or Flesch–Douma for Dutch, picked automatically), the average sentence length, the reading time and the five longest sentences, so you can see where a text gets heavy. Code blocks, front matter, links and Markdown syntax are left out of the count. Updates as you type.

plugins.name: Repeated words
plugins.description: A side panel listing words you use a lot in the open note, and accidental doubles like "the the".
plugins.author: Marky
plugins.details: Lists the words that appear most often (leaving out short common words in English and Dutch), how often, and any word written twice in a row. Useful when editing a text that keeps saying "important" or "solution". Code blocks and front matter are ignored.

plugins.name: Table of contents
plugins.description: Insert or refresh a linked table of contents (between <!-- toc --> markers) from the note's headings.
plugins.author: Marky

plugins.name: Word goal
plugins.description: Set a word-count target and see your progress in the status bar.
plugins.author: Marky examples
